note: Pose-quality measurement of the Waymo-3DSkelMo pipeline (the source of all pose inputs in this project), computed on the Waymo PERCEPTION validation split against lidar_hkp GT keypoints (the Motion split we train on has no GT). 40 segments, intersection of labeled+downloaded.
interpretation: Raw world-frame error (~5.0 m, uniform across joints) is a global placement/frame offset. Root-aligned MPJPE = 160.6 mm mean (152.9 median) is the pose-configuration quality. Extremities are worst (ankles/wrists 230-255 mm) - large relative to walking stride amplitude (~300-600 mm), so fine gait articulation is substantially noise in these pose estimates.
